stories.title: Death toll hits 22 after Russian missile strike on Ukraine's Pryluky
stories.summary: Rescuers pulled bodies from the rubble of a residential building in the northern Ukrainian town of Pryluky, where a Russian missile strike killed 22 people including five children and injured 54. The strike was part of a mass missile and drone barrage on Kyiv and a dozen other regions that coincided with Vladimir Putin's 74th birthday.

stories.title: Israel says British consulate in Jerusalem has ceased to function
stories.summary: Israel took down the sign outside the British consulate in East Jerusalem and said the building has stopped operating as a consulate, with about 20 diplomats leaving the country. Britain says it has reached an agreement with Israel that lets a small team of diplomats keep working there, defusing a standoff triggered by the UK ban on trade with Israeli settlements.

stories.title: Police fire tear gas at Paris school as French student protests continue
stories.summary: Officers cleared fresh barricades with tear gas at a high school in northeastern Paris as nationwide student protests over education funding continued; 375 schools were fully or partly closed Thursday and more than 6,600 arrests have been made since late September. The unrest is deepening pressure on France's embattled outgoing government.

stories.title: Tanker attacked off Qatar as oil tops $100
stories.summary: A tanker sailing off Qatar's north coast was attacked near the Strait of Hormuz, with Iran claiming the route carries oil, the latest in a run of attacks on ships. Oil rose above $100 amid reports the US is discussing military strikes before the midterms.

stories.title: TII releases Falcon-Emirati, an Emirati Arabic dialect model
stories.summary: Abu Dhabi's Technology Innovation Institute published Falcon-Emirati-7B, built on Falcon-H1-Arabic and tuned specifically for Emirati Arabic vocabulary, tone and cultural context rather than Modern Standard Arabic. The open-weights model is on Hugging Face and targets chat applications that need to sound like a native Gulf speaker.

stories.title: OpenAI says 372 new math results came mostly from one agent prompt
stories.summary: OpenAI disclosed 372 new mathematical results produced by an unreleased model, saying nearly all came from a single prompt to one AI agent at a fraction of the cost of the 10,000-agent swarm that worked on Navier-Stokes. The company withheld the prompts and per-problem compute times, drawing calls from advisory groups for fuller disclosure.

stories.title: OpenAI brings GPT-6 and interactive Intelligent UI to free ChatGPT users
stories.summary: OpenAI rolled GPT-6 with its new Intelligent UI out to Free and Go ChatGPT users globally, a day after paid tiers, letting answers render charts, buttons, forms and small tools instead of plain text. GPT-6 can also start answering while it is still reasoning, which OpenAI says cuts average wait for search-heavy questions by about 44%.

stories.title: Browns thin up front as three defensive linemen miss practice
stories.summary: Mason Graham (knee/ankle), Mike Hall Jr. (ankle) and Derek Barnett (ankle) all sat out Wednesday's practice, leaving Cleveland's defensive front shorthanded before Sunday's trip to the Jets. Defensive tackle Kalia Davis was activated off injured reserve for a limited session, while quarterback Dillon Gabriel practiced fully as his 21-day window opened.

stories.title: Browns' 3-1 start draws comparisons to 2025 Patriots
stories.summary: Cleveland's fast start under Todd Monken, helped by decisive roster moves such as starting rookie guard Austin Barber and promoting rookie receiver Denzel Boston, is being compared to Mike Vrabel's breakout 2025 Patriots season. A run of softer road opponents (Jets, Titans, Steelers, Saints) gives the Browns a chance to keep stacking wins.

stories.title: Monken's Browns head to MetLife to face the reeling Jets
stories.summary: Cleveland carries a three-game win streak into Sunday's road game against a Jets team that has lost three straight, having trailed or been tied in the fourth quarter of every win. Their latest comeback ended with Andre Szmyt's 56-yard field goal with 10 seconds left to beat Pittsburgh 27-24.

stories.title: Elgton Jenkins clears concussion protocol for Browns
stories.summary: Cleveland lineman Elgton Jenkins cleared the NFL's concussion protocol and practiced in full Wednesday, putting him on track to play Sunday against the Jets. He missed the Week 4 win over Pittsburgh after entering the protocol.

stories.title: Ohio State's transfer class breaks through in win at Iowa
stories.summary: Several of Ohio State's 2026 transfers had their best games in Saturday's 31-14 win at Iowa, led by safety Earl Little Jr., linebacker Alliegro and receiver Devin McCuin. Coach Ryan Day said the group is starting to build confidence as the Buckeyes move into the middle of the season.

stories.title: Ohio State depth chart set for Maryland homecoming game
stories.summary: The Columbus Dispatch published its projected Ohio State depth chart for Saturday's 4:15 p.m. ET homecoming kickoff against Maryland on BTN. The Buckeyes are 4-1 overall and 2-0 in Big Ten play after winning at Iowa.

stories.title: Banged-up receiver room opens door for Buckeyes freshmen
stories.summary: With Devin McCuin and Brandon Inniss listed questionable for Saturday's Maryland game, freshmen Chris Henry Jr. and Brock Boyd could see expanded targets. Day said the first-year receivers are playing with confidence, and LSU transfer Kyle Parker is expected to make his season debut.

stories.title: Ohio State's first availability report: safety out, four questionable
stories.summary: No. 5 Ohio State will be without safety Leroy Roker III against Maryland and lists right tackle Phillip Daniels, receivers Brandon Inniss and Devin McCuin and defensive lineman Khary Wilder as questionable. Cornerback Jay Timmons was cleared, and the Buckeyes are 34.5-point favorites over the Terrapins.

stories.title: Singapore Grand Prix preview: Marina Bay hosts round 17
stories.summary: Formula 1 moves to the Marina Bay Street Circuit for the Singapore Grand Prix, with Max Verstappen arriving in form after winning the rain-delayed race in Malaysia. The night race is the 17th round of the 2026 season and comes with an FIA heat-hazard declaration.

stories.title: Verstappen takes aim at Ferrari ahead of Singapore
stories.summary: Max Verstappen criticised Ferrari before the Singapore Grand Prix, with Red Bull arriving off a win in Malaysia following a poor start to 2026 that fuelled speculation he could leave the team at the end of the season. Verstappen has since shut down that talk.

stories.title: FIA declares heat hazard for Singapore Grand Prix
stories.summary: The FIA declared a heat-hazard race for the Singapore Grand Prix, the second weekend in a row and fourth time this season, after forecasts predicted a heat index above 31C and track temperatures near 56C. The designation allows driver cooling systems and gives teams cost-cap allowances for developing them.

stories.title: Historic downtown Columbus Mercantile building sells for 8.9 million
stories.summary: The historic Mercantile building in downtown Columbus was sold to Washington, D.C.-based Rampart Capital for 8.9 million dollars, the firm's first acquisition in Central Ohio. The deal adds to a wave of downtown office sales at steep discounts to previous values.

stories.title: Columbus fire officials warn on lithium-ion battery charging
stories.summary: During Fire Prevention Week, Columbus and Ohio fire officials urged residents to use manufacturer-approved chargers, charge large batteries such as e-bikes and power tools outdoors, and unplug devices that get hot. Lt. Nicholas Davis warned that lithium-ion failures can spread from a garage fire to an entire building.

stories.title: Pickerington schools cut 3.25M with levy decision looming
stories.summary: Pickerington Local Schools trimmed about 3.25 million dollars from this year's budget, eliminating six administrative positions in a first phase of cuts, with further phases hinging on a 10-year, 0.75% income tax levy on the Nov. 3 ballot that would raise about 21.9 million dollars a year. Voters rejected a larger request in May.

stories.title: Columbus College of Art & Design opens new center for students
stories.summary: Columbus College of Art & Design opened a new center for students, adding space on its downtown campus. The opening continues investment in the city's Discovery District arts and education corridor.
